name: t11_statuses_exact
doc: World-depth Stage 5, slice 2a (2026-11-26), chance-free: the Status Catalogue rows Off Guard, Bound, Charmed, Drunk and Sleep, the caster hold and the stop_clock ready-art fix. A: a lullaby that puts B to sleep (its clock stops 3 s; A is held while B sleeps, and A's companion strike every 2 s wakes B early for 20 % less); a charming fan (B's arts wait 2 s, A is held; A's free hit every 3 s ends it); Water wine laying 2 Drunk stacks at a time (each on its own 3 s; B's timers run slower, B's aim drops, and at 3+ stacks A's Water parts hit B 10 % harder). B has accuracy 1, so its lost aim never opens an evade chance. B: a hook that leaves A Off Guard (evade 0, no draw) and Bound for 2 s, a slicing art and a heal; a 'status.bound' reader that counts the pulses A is Bound.
